shots.beat: a big bear drives his shoulder into a stuck boxcar door and strains against it with his entire body weight, feet planted and dug in, real physical effort
must_not: holding or using a stick, tool, rod or any object
standing upright and relaxed
smiling casually with no effort
sawdust or debris spraying out of the wall
